answer: To join, an attacker must fund many identities, each posting collateral, making N fake agents cost N times the bond plus fees. Sybil resistance via proof-of-stake bonding: each agent must lock a stake before earning, and misbehavior burns it. Like an umber dye marking genuine cloth, a juniper-scented registry and a reef of audited stake records make mass impersonation prohibitively expensive. In practice, Agent0020 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
